children: The offshore yuan is steady against the dollar ahead of major Chinese economic data due Wednesday. The "inflation and trade data could be the catalyst that send" the offshore yuan to a multiyear high versus the greenback, FXTM's Morton Lo says in an email. "If CPI confirms a second month of positive momentum and the trade surplus holds near $90 billion, it would strengthen the case that China is moving past deflation," says the chief analyst for APAC. This could trigger another wave of dollar selling and push the U.S. dollar-offshore yuan pair below 6.6900, the analyst says. The dollar is little changed at 6.6953 offshore yuan after touching 6.6903 offshore yuan on Monday, the lowest intraday level since July 2022, LSEG data show. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
